What we’ve done so far:
- Automatically routed affected traffic to healthy pools (mitigation applied ~08:20 PDT)
- Prioritized reconnect and KV cache warm-up for active sessions
- Opened a high-priority incident in engineering and set the status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-08-22-hosted-api-impact

Immediate ask: can you confirm whether you saw failed requests for user-facing flows or back-end batch jobs? That will help us scope any potential data-delivery gaps.

We’ll send a short follow-up with an initial timeline and proposed next steps for a post-incident call. Attaching a short timeline stub we’ll expand into a postmortem.

Subject: Hosted API incident follow-up and post-incident materials (ClymbHealth)

Hi Asha,

Thanks again for the quick heads-up on Saturday — we completed a targeted investigation and wanted to share the high-level findings and next steps.

Summary (high level):
- Window: 2026-08-22 08:05–09:00 PDT
- Impact: elevated 5xx rate for ~18% of generation traffic routed via a single US-west pool; visible as increased p95 and intermittent 502s for some customers in the SF region. No evidence of data loss or unauthorized access.
- Root cause (short): an edge routing controller misconfiguration caused an unhealthy pool to be excluded from graceful draining, amplifying transient failures when traffic shifted.

What we did:
- Immediate mitigation: manual reweighting to healthy pools and a routing policy rollback (~08:20 PDT)
- Follow-up: applied tighter health-check intervals and a guard to prevent similar misconfig changes; improved automatic fallback thresholds

Next steps and offer:
- We’ll share a full incident timeline and technical postmortem in the Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/Clymb-Incident-2026-08-22
- Proposed customer call: Tue 2026-08-24 11:00 AM PT (30 min) — confirm if that works for you and your ops team
- Goodwill: Ben and Marissa proposed a one-time account credit (prelim 10% of last month’s hosted API spend). We’ll confirm the exact credit after Eng finalizes the impacted-request estimate.

Attached: finalized postmortem (PDF) and a short template we used to draft the customer credit note.

[Attachment: redwood_incident_postmortem_clymb_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: customer_cc_template.txt]

If you’d like, we can also schedule a short engineering walkthrough of the change and remediation plan. Apologies again for the disruption — we appreciate your partnership and will follow up with the final numbers and any further remediations.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference
